resources.string: Create and finish a game to fill your history.
This game will disappear from the resume panel. It will not be shown in history.
Game rules, third-party libraries, and app version.
Open source libraries used by the app.

Each player rolls 5 dice and has up to 3 rolls per turn. After the first roll, they may keep some dice and reroll the others. The final result is written in an open score sheet category. A filled category cannot be played again.

The upper section scores Ones to Sixes and gives a 35-point bonus from 63 points. The lower section contains Three of a Kind, Four of a Kind, Full House, Small Straight, Large Straight, Yahtzee, and Chance. A Yahtzee is worth 50 points, with a possible 100-point bonus for each extra Yahtzee under the official rules.

The French variant often uses two columns: Free, chosen after the rolls, and Announced, chosen before rolling. The main categories are Ones to Sixes, Chance, Three of a Kind, Four of a Kind, Full House, Small Straight, Large Straight, and Yams. Some combination values can vary by table.
When every required category is filled or scratched, add the scores, apply active bonuses, and compare totals. The highest score wins.
